target: Recover the stopped atomic-idempotency repair without reopening its architecture. Fix four verified defects: ConPort owner tests cannot import enhanced_server, Task Orchestrator route tests cannot collect because the FastMCP stub rejects name= and description=, fingerprint v1 incorrectly sorts ordered immutable lists, and prior diff evidence omits newly added files. Then rerun the complete test matrix, prove concurrency across two Task Orchestrator processes, obtain trusted exact-head audit evidence, package every authoritative artifact, and run PR Steward.
invariants: The persistent atomic-claim design remains unchanged unless a newly passing test proves a correctness defect.
Production MCP registration code must not be weakened to satisfy a stub.
Fingerprint v1 preserves Pydantic-normalized order for acceptance_criteria and tags.
Reordered list values are distinct immutable requests and must conflict.
The fingerprint contract version and field set remain unchanged.
Owner-level tests must import and exercise EnhancedConPortServer.
Complete diff evidence must include new and modified files.
No force push, rebase, reset, history rewrite, branch deletion, merge, deployment, canonical service restart, or PR ready-state transition is authorized.
The two-replica proof must use two independently addressable Task Orchestrator processes sharing one authenticated bridge and one ConPort owner.
At least 20 identical and 20 conflicting concurrent rounds, restart replay, one row per identity, and zero overwrite are mandatory.
No secret, JWT, signing key, cookie, authorization header, or environment file may enter git, proof, audit prompts, process arguments, or final bundles.
Trusted embedded audit must execute its substantive step and bind to the final PR head.
PR Steward must use tools/pr_steward with schemas/pr_steward.
A successful run still does not authorize merge, deployment, or LTAIP loader retry.

pr.body:
## Summary
- Repair ConPort owner test import using established adjacent-test convention
- Repair FastMCP test stub to accept production decorator shape
- Fingerprint v1 preserves Pydantic-normalized order for acceptance_criteria and tags
- Reordered lists are distinct immutable requests and conflict on replay
- Complete diff evidence includes new and modified files
- Two-replica concurrency proof with restart replay
- Trusted exact-head embedded audit

## Safety
- No protocol, schema, or persistence-provider change
- No runtime sys.path mutation
- Production MCP registration unchanged
- Fingerprint contract version and field set unchanged
- Draft PR, no force push, no merge authorization

steps.task: Prove live Git/GitHub custody: PR head, remote branch head, lineage, candidate completeness.
validation: PR head equals remote branch head
Reported candidate is descendant of authorized parent
Candidate contains every expected REPAIR-003 file

steps.task: Fix test_custom_data_atomic_claim.py using the repository's established adjacent-test import convention so EnhancedConPortServer imports and executes.
validation: 20 identical claims: 1 CREATED, 19 MATCHED, 1 persisted value
20 conflicting claims: 1 CREATED, 19 CONFLICT, 1 persisted value, 0 overwrites

steps.task: Fix the FastMCP test stub to accept tool(name=..., description=...) while preserving the wrapped callable.
Replace sorted lists with Pydantic-normalized order in fingerprint v1. Add reordered-list conflict tests.
Run the complete scoped validation matrix. Every command must exit 0.
validation: Route and atomic idempotency tests pass

steps.task: Capture precommit diff evidence, stage only authorized files, commit, capture final implementation head and patch.
validation: Final commit patch includes every newly added packet and test file

steps.task: Fast-forward the existing draft PR with pre-push remote verification and post-push head verification.
validation: Post-push PR head equals final implementation head

steps.task: Run a disposable two-replica isolated concurrency proof: one ConPort owner, one authenticated DopeconBridge, two independently addressable Task Orchestrator processes, unique loopback ports, unique network and volumes, unique synthetic data, short-lived synthetic credentials.
validation: 20 identical concurrent rounds, 20 conflicting concurrent rounds, 1 process restart replay, 0 failed rounds, 0 overwrites, 1 row maximum per identity, 0 token leaks, 0 residual resources

steps.task: Obtain trusted exact-head embedded audit bound to the final PR head inspecting the complete diff, test harness repairs, fingerprint ordering semantics, ConPort owner transaction, two-replica concurrency proof, bridge authentication, token handling, evidence custody, and allowlist compliance.
validation: Verdict PASS or PASS_WITH_RISKS with no blocking finding
Audit records tool, model, invocation, exit code, audited head, inspected files, findings, fixes, remaining risks, instruction-like-content scan

steps.task: Assemble the clean evidence bundle, run check-only PR Steward, and produce HANDOFF.json.
validation: Bundle contains all Git receipts, test outputs, final patch, concurrency receipts, token scan, cleanup proof, embedded audit, PR Steward outputs, HANDOFF.json
No .DS_Store, AppleDouble, caches, environment files, secrets, raw authorization headers
PR Steward intake passes with strict mode
